reason: 要旨: Reconstruction and simulation at a collider experiment are long chains of specialised algorithms, each tuned to a single step. We explore how one model can serve many of those steps at once, while still producing the intermediate objects (tracks, calorimeter cells, clusters, particles and jets) that make the chain。要旨上の主題は対象契約のLLM inference/serving効率、推論時圧縮に該当しない。
title: Prompting Particle Physics: Tokenized Multi-modal Foundation Models for Combinatorially Many Tasks
